integrity: Self-contained analytic reduction and Taylor expansion; finite independent multistart numerical checks do not establish universal optimality, publication priority, or external scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Global energy minimizers for one positive exceptional edge on simple odd rings with n>=5 only; Euler sinks for sufficiently small steps away from threshold. No complete equilibrium or basin classification; historical priority relative to older classical defective XY rings may require further independent scrutiny.
title: A sharp weak-link chirality transition on every odd repulsive oscillator ring
